text:
Maya: Heads up — Dalia from Ops is flying in and landing at 10:00. Meeting at 10:30 by the Embarcadero. She has a severe nut allergy and is vegan. Need oat‑milk coffee + guaranteed nut‑free snack near Ferry Building. Any recs?
Omar: Blue Bottle (Montgomery) has oat milk lattes but pastries likely cross‑contaminated. not great for allergies.
Devon: Sightglass (3rd & Market) will usually label allergens if you ask, but still risky.
Sylvie: Fresh & Go inside Ferry Bldg does prepacked chia puddings and fruit cups, all labeled vegan and nut‑free options. I’d trust their sealed stuff.
Maya: Perfect — sealed is ideal. Can someone pick up? I’ll Venmo. :pray:
Devon: I can swing by on my way. What should I grab exactly?
Maya: Two oat milk lattes, 1 sealed chia pudding (vegan, nut‑free label), and a sealed fruit cup. Thanks!!
Devon: Copy. ETA ~9:55. I’ll DM payment.
Omar: If Fresh & Go sells out, second choice is 'Blue Barn Kitchen' in Embarcadero Center — they have an individually wrapped apple + prepack hummus packs.
Sylvie: Also FYI — Ferry Building vendors rotate, if it’s busy check the sealed‑goods cooler near the back.
Devon: Ordering now.
